name: Project Schedule Management
excerpt: Project Schedule Management involves tracking and managing the project schedule.
notes:
- Project Schedule Management includes knowing the status of the schedule and influencing factors that can cause schedule issues.

- Project Schedule Management involves managing slipped milestones, which are milestones reached later than expected.

- Project Schedule Management involves the processes required to manage the timely completion of the project.
- It includes activities such as defining activities, sequencing activities, estimating activity durations, and developing and controlling the schedule.

- Project Schedule Management is closely related to Project Time Management, focusing on the scheduling aspect of time management.
